title: Clip.view (children)
contract: A get-only child refers to the clip's Clip.View; no independent view mutation is declared by this child.

title: Clip.available_warp_modes (properties)
contract: For an audio clip, the read-only list contains indexes of available Warp Modes, rather than a promise that every published mode is supported.

title: Clip.color (properties)
contract: The integer is a packed RGB color; setting it chooses a nearest color in the clip chooser. Packing and nearest-choice prose is not a target color metric or tie rule.

title: Clip.color_index (properties)
contract: An integer clip color index is get/set/observable; the declaration supplies no complete index palette.

title: Clip.end_marker (properties)
contract: A beat-valued end marker is independent of loop state and cannot be set earlier than the start marker; refusal/error details are omitted.

title: Clip.end_time (properties)
contract: The read/observable end time has separate Session Loop End versus End Marker and Arrangement right-edge contexts.

title: Clip.gain (properties)
contract: An audio-only float gain is documented on a normalized zero-to-one domain; it is not a new fader-to-amplitude law.

title: Clip.gain_display_string (properties)
contract: For audio clips, a get-only symbol presents a gain display string; the example does not define locale, precision or formatting grammar.

title: Clip.file_path (properties)
contract: For audio clips, a get-only symbol identifies the represented audio file location; this supplies no path normalization or file-access policy.

title: Clip.groove (properties)
contract: A Groove-valued get/set/observable association is documented, with a since-Live11 note; object identity and removal semantics remain unproved.

title: Clip.has_envelopes (properties)
contract: The read/observable boolean reports whether the clip has automation, without specifying serialized envelope ownership or scheduling.

title: Clip.has_groove (properties)
contract: A get-only boolean reports a Groove association; the source does not make it an observable property.

title: Clip.is_session_clip (properties)
contract: A get-only boolean identifies a Session clip; the source distinguishes Session from Arrangement membership.

title: Clip.is_arrangement_clip (properties)
contract: A get-only boolean identifies an Arrangement clip, without declaring a clip-transfer operation.

title: Clip.is_take_lane_clip (properties)
contract: A get-only boolean identifies Take Lane membership; the source explicitly also classifies Take Lane clips as Arrangement clips.

title: Clip.is_audio_clip (properties)
contract: A get-only boolean distinguishes audio from MIDI clips using the published boolean convention.

title: Clip.is_midi_clip (properties)
contract: The get-only boolean is described as opposite to is_audio_clip; it is not an input-conversion operation.

title: Clip.is_overdubbing (properties)
contract: A read/observable boolean reports overdubbing; recording engine and note-merge laws remain separate.

title: Clip.is_playing (properties)
contract: The source declares get/set access to a boolean that includes recording in the playing state; it does not declare observe or specify the setting transition.

title: Clip.is_recording (properties)
contract: A read/observable boolean reports clip recording, without asserting captured media or note content.

title: Clip.is_triggered (properties)
contract: A get-only boolean corresponds to a blinking Clip Launch button; it is distinct from already playing or recording.

title: Clip.launch_mode (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer names Trigger, Gate, Toggle and Repeat in the current reference. Published indexes/default do not replace the finite launch owner.

title: Clip.launch_quantization (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer names Global, None and listed bar/straight/triplet divisions. The reference indexes do not establish new launch-grid timing.

title: Clip.legato (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable boolean corresponds to the Legato switch in Launch settings, not a derived playback-position rule.

title: Clip.length (properties)
contract: Read-only length is loop length when looped and start-to-end distance otherwise, in beats; the source says it is not meaningful for unwarped audio.

title: Clip.loop_end (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float denotes loop end when looped and clip end otherwise; context-dependent units are described alongside loop_start.

title: Clip.loop_jump (properties)
contract: Observe-only bang notification corresponds to crossing the loop-start position, including a possible projection into the loop; cadence and exact event payload remain unverified.

title: Clip.loop_start (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float denotes loop start or unlooped clip start. MIDI/warped clips use absolute clip beats; unwarped audio uses seconds from the first sample.

title: Clip.looping (properties)
contract: The get/set/observable boolean enables looping; the source excludes looping of unwarped audio, without specifying invalid-write behavior.

title: Clip.muted (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable boolean denotes the Clip Activator being off; this does not specify a sample-level mute ramp.

title: Clip.name (properties)
contract: The source declares a symbol-valued get/set/observable name and gives no further grammar, maximum length or normalization law.

title: Clip.notes (properties)
contract: For MIDI clips only, an observe-only bang signals that the note list changed, not a returned note collection or a complete event ordering protocol.

title: Clip.warp_markers (properties)
contract: For audio clips, get returns a dictionary of sample_time and beat_time pairs while observe bangs on changes. The source includes an invisible final marker and interpolation context, retained under the existing Warp owner.

title: Clip.pitch_coarse (properties)
contract: The audio-only get/set/observable integer describes semitone Transpose, with the published minus48-to48 range; this is not a sound or tuning oracle.

title: Clip.pitch_fine (properties)
contract: The audio-only get/set/observable float describes cent Detune, with the published minus50-to49 range; rounding and audible pitch remain unknown here.

title: Clip.playing_position (properties)
contract: The read/observable float uses absolute clip beats for MIDI/warped audio and seconds for unwarped audio; stopped position is described as zero, without callback cadence or timing tolerance.

title: Clip.playing_status (properties)
contract: An observe-only bang signals a change in playing/trigger status, without a complete transition order or event count.

title: Clip.position (properties)
contract: The access line says get/observe, but prose describes setting loop position while preserving loop length and equating its value to loop_start. This conflict remains Q-LCS-001; write capability is not silently added.

title: Clip.ram_mode (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable boolean corresponds to an audio clip's RAM switch; no cache, memory or streaming architecture is mandated.

title: Clip.sample_length (properties)
contract: A get-only integer describes the clip sample length in samples; this supplies no decoder or duration rounding law.

title: Clip.sample_rate (properties)
contract: A get-only float reports the clip sample rate; exact source-rate conversion and valid contexts are not otherwise specified here.

title: Clip.signature_denominator (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer is declared for the signature denominator; admissible values and invalid-write policy are not given.

title: Clip.signature_numerator (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer is declared for the signature numerator; admissible values and invalid-write policy are not given.

title: Clip.start_marker (properties)
contract: A beat-valued get/set/observable start marker is loop-independent and cannot be placed after the end marker; equality and error handling require evidence.

title: Clip.start_time (properties)
contract: A read/observable float describes song-relative start beats, with different Arrangement offset and Session start roles. Session reporting concerns the track's currently playing clip and may be negative after offsets.

title: Clip.velocity_amount (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float describes how triggering-note velocity affects volume, with zero/no-effect and one/full-effect source endpoints; no interpolation or audio law is inferred.

title: Clip.warp_mode (properties)
contract: The audio-only get/set/observable integer names Beats, Tones, Texture, Re-Pitch, Complex, REX and Complex Pro in this Clip reference; available_warp_modes and the existing finite owner remain necessary.

title: Clip.warping (properties)
contract: The audio-only get/set/observable boolean corresponds to Warp enablement. The source warns of deferred setting and sequencing surprises; no private scheduling design or delay guarantee follows.

title: Clip.will_record_on_start (properties)
contract: A get-only boolean has the joint MIDI-clip, triggered, track-armed and MIDI Arrangement Overdub prerequisites; a lone true flag does not prove recorded notes.

title: Clip.add_new_notes (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, the dictionary's notes list contains pitch:int, start_time:float and duration:float, with optional velocity, mute, probability, velocity_deviation and release_velocity fields. A list of newly added note IDs is described as returned; defaults/ranges stay current-source context, not storage or RNG laws.

title: Clip.add_warp_marker (functions)
contract: For warped audio only, a marker dictionary has beat_time and optional sample_time floats. Omitted sample_time is described as preserving timing; explicit sample_time has sample-span, adjacent-order and segment-BPM constraints owned by Warp markers, not new target arithmetic here.

title: Clip.apply_note_modifications (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, a notes dictionary uses note records returned by get_notes_extended; a subset is admitted but the source says a batch containing any absent note is ignored. No partial-commit or event-order protocol is inferred.

title: Clip.clear_all_envelopes (functions)
contract: The function removes all clip automation according to the source; no return value, undo transaction or sample-accurate side effect is declared.

title: Clip.clear_envelope (functions)
contract: A device_parameter argument is documented as an id; its associated clip automation is removed. Valid parameter identity and envelope ownership must be established independently.

title: Clip.crop (functions)
contract: Cropping uses the loop region when looped and start/end-marker region otherwise. This describes the API operation's region choice, not media rewrite bytes or an implementation of crop.

title: Clip.deselect_all_notes (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, deselects notes; the source suggests using it before replace_selected_notes and documents a named id-zero output. That referenced function is not declared in this selected Clip body and is not added to the denominator.

title: Clip.duplicate_loop (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, the loop doubles and notes/envelopes duplicate; for an unlooped clip the start/end range is used. Existing region/note/envelope owners retain exact transforms and boundaries.

title: Clip.duplicate_notes_by_id (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, accepts existing note IDs as a list or a dictionary with note_ids and optional destination_time:float/int and transposition_amount:int. Omitted destination follows the selected notes; exact insertion arithmetic is not derived here.

title: Clip.duplicate_region (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, region_start, region_length and destination_time are float/int arguments, with optional pitch:int and transposition_amount:int. The source describes pitch-minus1 as all pitches and transposition, without supplying a new region endpoint law.

title: Clip.fire (functions)
contract: The function is described by the Clip Launch button role, without an argument or return declaration; existing launch/playback owners retain actual dispatch and timing.

title: Clip.get_all_notes_extended (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, returns a notes dictionary irrespective of markers/loop bounds. Each record has note_id, pitch, start_time, duration, velocity, mute, probability, velocity_deviation and release_velocity; an optional dictionary return-key list selects fields.

title: Clip.get_notes_by_id (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, existing IDs are passed as a list or a dictionary with note_ids and optional return field-selection list; the returned notes dictionary contains the published record fields. Missing-ID policy is not specified by this valid-ID precondition.

title: Clip.get_notes_extended (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, from_pitch:int, pitch_span:int, from_time:float and time_span:float select note starts; times are beats. The alternative dictionary uses these keys and optional return field list; returned records contain the published extended note fields.

title: Clip.get_selected_notes_extended (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, returns selected-note records with the published extended fields; an optional dictionary return field-list narrows the record keys. Selection identity and ordering remain separate questions.

title: Clip.move_playing_pos (functions)
contract: A beats:float argument requests an unquantized relative jump, including negative/backward direction. Unwarped audio, recording audio and recording non-overdub MIDI are expressly excluded; no scheduling or jump-sample oracle is added.

title: Clip.move_warp_marker (functions)
contract: beat_time:float identifies a marker and beat_time_distance:float requests its movement; exact constraints/conversions stay with the existing Warp owner.

title: Clip.quantize (functions)
contract: quantization_grid:int and amount:float request quantization of all clip notes with song swing_amount taken into account; no grid enum, rounding, swing or numeric transform is inferred.

title: Clip.quantize_pitch (functions)
contract: pitch:int, quantization_grid:int and amount:float apply the quantize role to one pitch; the source does not supply an independent quantization algorithm.

title: Clip.remove_notes_by_id (functions)
contract: A list of IDs associated with existing notes requests deletion of those notes; note-ID lifetime, invalid batches and serialization are not derived from this valid-ID statement.

title: Clip.remove_notes_extended (functions)
contract: from_pitch:int, pitch_span:int, from_time:float and time_span:float request deletion of notes whose starts lie in the area; times are beats, but edge inclusivity remains unresolved.

title: Clip.remove_warp_marker (functions)
contract: beat_time:float identifies the marker requested for removal; marker-count, shadow and refusal constraints retain the existing Warp owner.

title: Clip.scrub (functions)
contract: beat_time:float requests mouse-like scrubbing that respects Global Quantization and continues until stop_scrub. This is a dispatch role, without a new transport or sample-timing law.

title: Clip.select_all_notes (functions)
contract: For MIDI clips, selects all notes independently of prior selection; the source documents a named id-zero output, not a new note-ID protocol.

title: Clip.select_notes_by_id (functions)
contract: A list of note IDs selects associated notes; unlike other valid-ID descriptions, the source explicitly says nonexistent IDs do not print a warning/error. Actual result selection and message delivery remain target-U.

title: Clip.set_fire_button_state (functions)
contract: state:bool represents a held clip-start button when true until false or another stop; it is not a proof of Gate/Toggle/Repeat timing or release policy.

title: Clip.stop (functions)
contract: The function has the track-stop-button role only for this clip actually playing or recording; a merely triggered clip or another clip playing has no effect according to the source.

title: Clip.stop_scrub (functions)
contract: The function stops an active scrub; inactive, deleted-object and transport transition policies are not specified.

title: Clip.View.grid_is_triplet (properties)
contract: A get/set boolean controls whether the displayed clip grid is triplet; observe access is not declared.

title: Clip.View.grid_quantization (properties)
contract: A get/set integer controls displayed grid quantization; no enum or exact note-quantization law is supplied.

title: Clip.View.hide_envelope (functions)
contract: The function hides the Envelopes box, without a declared parameter or return value.

title: Clip.View.select_envelope_parameter (functions)
contract: A DeviceParameter argument selects that parameter in the Envelopes box; invalid or absent envelope parameters require separate evidence.

title: Clip.View.show_envelope (functions)
contract: The function shows the Envelopes box; API return/callback and focus side effects remain unknown.

title: Clip.View.show_loop (functions)
contract: Only when the clip is visible in Detail View, the function brings its current loop into view; this does not declare zoom geometry or a hidden-clip selection operation.

title: Sample.beats_granulation_resolution (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer selects Beats divisions from a bar through thirty-seconds or Transients, as listed; it does not specify a time-stretch algorithm.

title: Sample.beats_transient_envelope (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float describes the per-segment fade duration in Beats mode, with source endpoints fastest decay and no fade; no numeric envelope curve is established.

title: Sample.beats_transient_loop_mode (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer selects Off, Forward or Back-and-Forth per-segment transient looping in Beats mode; no audio boundary algorithm follows.

title: Sample.complex_pro_envelope (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float controls the Envelope parameter in Complex Pro mode; range, units and signal law are omitted.

title: Sample.complex_pro_formants (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float controls the Formants parameter in Complex Pro mode; range, units and signal law are omitted.

title: Sample.end_marker (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer denotes the sample end-marker position; the member body does not explicitly give units or bounds.

title: Sample.file_path (properties)
contract: A read/observable unicode property identifies the sample file path; write access is not declared.

title: Sample.gain (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float controls sample gain; this declaration supplies no range, units, mapping or clipping law.

title: Sample.length (properties)
contract: A get-only integer gives sample-file length in sample frames, not clip beats or bytes.

title: Sample.sample_rate (properties)
contract: A get-only integer gives the loaded sample rate; this differs from Clip's float declaration and is not silently coerced.

title: Sample.slices (properties)
contract: A read/observable list of integers gives playable-slice positions in sample frames. The source describes division by sample_rate for seconds; no target numerical conversion or rounding oracle is added.

title: Sample.slicing_sensitivity (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float controls slicing sensitivity in the published zero-to-one domain; threshold/detection and clamp behavior are not supplied.

title: Sample.start_marker (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer denotes sample start-marker position; units, equality and refusal policy are not explicitly declared by this member.

title: Sample.texture_flux (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float controls Flux in Texture mode; no range or randomness law is inferred.

title: Sample.texture_grain_size (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float controls Grain Size in Texture mode; no units or synthesis law are supplied.

title: Sample.tones_grain_size (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable float controls Grain Size in Tones mode; no units or synthesis law are supplied.

title: Sample.warp_markers (properties)
contract: Get returns a marker dictionary and observe bangs on changes. The source describes a hidden final marker for the last segment's BPM but does not repeat Clip's dictionary schema; it is not fabricated by inheritance.

title: Sample.warp_mode (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer names Beats, Tones, Texture, Re-Pitch, Complex and Complex Pro. The Sample list omits Clip's REX entry; these lists are not unified or used to replace finite Warp storage enums.

title: Sample.warping (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable boolean denotes Warp enabled, without borrowing Clip's deferral warning as a Sample guarantee.

title: Sample.slicing_style (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer names Transient, Beat, Region and Manual slicing modes; the numeric list is current-source context only.

title: Sample.slicing_beat_division (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer selects the listed straight/triplet divisions or bar multiples in Beat Slicing mode; no region generation or boundary law is inferred.

title: Sample.slicing_region_count (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer selects region count in Region Slicing mode; admissible count domain and partition rounding remain unknown.

title: Sample.gain_display_string (functions)
contract: The function explicitly returns a list of symbols representing gain text; unlike Clip's gain_display_string property, this is a function. Example formatting is not a locale/precision grammar.

title: Sample.insert_slice (functions)
contract: slice_time:int requests adding a slice only when one is absent at that time; unit, valid interval, duplicates and resulting IDs require evidence.

title: Sample.move_slice (functions)
contract: source_time:int and destination_time:int request moving an existing slice; collision, ordering and endpoint policy are not specified.

title: Sample.remove_slice (functions)
contract: slice_time:int requests removal if a slice exists there; minimum-slice and absent-slice event policies are not specified.

title: Sample.clear_slices (functions)
contract: The function clears slices created in Manual Slicing mode; it does not claim deletion of arbitrary automatic-mode slices or sample audio.

title: Sample.reset_slices (functions)
contract: The function returns edited slices to original positions; original-baseline identity and interaction with added/removed slices are not specified.

title: SimplerDevice.sample (children)
contract: A get/observable Sample child represents the currently loaded sample; object replacement and old-ID invalidation are separate lifecycle questions.

title: SimplerDevice.can_warp_as (properties)
contract: A read/observable boolean indicates availability of warp_as, not successful execution or an inferred availability formula.

title: SimplerDevice.can_warp_double (properties)
contract: A read/observable boolean indicates availability of warp_double; the source does not define its exact capability predicate.

title: SimplerDevice.can_warp_half (properties)
contract: A read/observable boolean indicates availability of warp_half; unavailable capability is not a negative success.

title: SimplerDevice.multi_sample_mode (properties)
contract: A read/observable boolean indicates multisample mode; transitions and sample-child behavior in this mode are not specified.

title: SimplerDevice.pad_slicing (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable boolean enables adding slices in Slicing mode by playing notes not assigned to existing slices; note-to-slice mapping is not supplied.

title: SimplerDevice.playback_mode (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer names Classic, One-Shot and Slicing; it does not prove the full voice/envelope/signal law of any mode.

title: SimplerDevice.playing_position (properties)
contract: A read/observable float gives a source-described normalized sample position between zero and one; update cadence, stopped values and interpolation are not specified.

title: SimplerDevice.playing_position_enabled (properties)
contract: A read/observable boolean jointly describes sample playback and displayed position; it is not a settable enable control in this reference.

title: SimplerDevice.retrigger (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable boolean denotes Retrigger enabled; exact voice restart or phase behavior remains owned by Simpler and unresolved where not evidenced.

title: SimplerDevice.slicing_playback_mode (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer names Mono, Poly and Thru for Slicing playback; note allocation and release law are not inferred.

title: SimplerDevice.voices (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer selects voice count; no admissible domain, stealing order or audio implementation is supplied.

title: SimplerDevice.crop (functions)
contract: The function crops the loaded sample to the active start/end-marker region; file identity, destructive/non-destructive behavior and exact sample output remain unknown.

title: SimplerDevice.guess_playback_length (functions)
contract: The function explicitly returns a float estimate of beat-time playback length between start/end markers; the estimation algorithm, accuracy and determinism are not supplied.

title: SimplerDevice.reverse (functions)
contract: The function reverses the loaded sample according to the source, without specifying file rewriting, markers, Warp, slice transforms or waveform oracles.

title: SimplerDevice.warp_as (functions)
contract: beats:int requests warping the active start/end-marker region to that beat count; capability must be admitted via can_warp_as, and numeric/audio laws remain with Warp/Simpler owners.

title: SimplerDevice.warp_double (functions)
contract: The function requests doubling playback tempo for the active start/end-marker region; can_warp_double is an independent availability prerequisite, not a derived two-times waveform oracle.

title: SimplerDevice.warp_half (functions)
contract: The function requests halving playback tempo for the active start/end-marker region; can_warp_half is an independent prerequisite, without a new time-stretch law.

title: SimplerDevice.replace_sample (functions)
contract: file_path:symbol must name an absolute path to a valid supported audio file; it requests replacement of the loaded sample. Format eligibility, dependencies, object lifetime and media bytes remain separately owned.

title: SimplerDevice.View.selected_slice (properties)
contract: A get/set/observable integer identifies the selected slice by its slice time, rather than an inferred list index; empty/missing-slice and unit semantics remain unknown.

title: Target applicability and inherited closure
contract: Exact12.4.3 presence, signatures and behavior of all five current-public references remain unknown. SimplerDevice inherits Device and SimplerDevice.View inherits Device.View by source description only; no generic inherited members are flattened or counted as specified here.

title: Access and type refusal
contract: Wrong property types, read-only writes, unsupported observation and function arity/return/error policy remain unknown, including Clip position access/prose disagreement. No bridge success/failure format is supplied here.

title: Object and capability lifetime
contract: Missing/deleted clip, replaced sample, stale ID, missing view, absent warp capability and multisample contexts remain unknown; unavailable prerequisites are not negative passes.

title: Notes dictionary and identity
contract: Malformed note dictionaries, absent/duplicate/stale IDs, mixed valid-invalid batches, optional return lists, field coercion, ordering and atomicity remain unknown except explicitly retained source predicates; storage IDs and API IDs are not presumed identical.

title: Clip context and region boundaries
contract: Audio/MIDI, Session/Arrangement/TakeLane, recording/overdub, loop/Warp and start/end relationships require independent context evidence; edge equality, reversed/empty intervals and unit conversion remain unknown where not already owned.

title: Warp, slice and mode dependencies
contract: Warp availability/mode changes, slice collision/minimum counts, original reset baselines, multisample and playback/slicing mode dependencies remain unknown; Clip and Sample marker dictionaries/enums are not unified.

title: Tuning, expression and quantization
contract: Tuning/MPE, note probability/velocity deviation, grid/swing/amount and voice/retrigger interactions are not numeric, RNG, MIDI-message or signal laws derived from member names.

title: Media and dependency operations
contract: Sample replacement/crop/reverse, clip crop and RAM/gain/path roles give no file rewrite, codec/dependency/cache/format, gain/sound or transaction guarantees.

title: Event, transport and rate lifecycle
contract: Observer payload/cadence/order, stopped/playing/recording transitions, transport jumps, Warp deferral and sample-rate effects remain unknown; a bang description is not an event-count or timing oracle.

title: Persistence and transactional editing
contract: Undo/redo, cancellation, save/reopen, object/track reorder and cross-object identity preservation remain unknown; existing finite storage rules are not proof of API transactions.

title: Initialization and teardown
contract: Binding before initialization, closing/reopening Set/device/clip view, observer detach/rebind, source loss and teardown behavior remain unknown and retain generic bridge ownership.

title: Undeclared units and signatures
contract: Where these bodies omit units, ranges, argument forms, returns or access, those details remain unknown. Clip.View grid indexes and Sample marker/slice argument units are not guessed from UI or similarly named fields.
